meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 执行后,Claude 会把 Google Chat 适配器复制进项目、注册为频道、安装固定版本依赖,并运行构建和测试;之后还需你按提示在 Google Cloud 完成凭据设置。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Google Chat 频道集成,或提出“接入 Google Chat”等请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Google Chat 接入项目。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并注册频道。

say.text: 添加 Google Chat 频道支持。
say.note: 会安装依赖并跑构建测试。
按流程完成配置并提示后续步骤。

howto.what_en: After running, Claude copies the Google Chat adapter into the project, registers it as a channel, installs a pinned dependency, and runs build and tests; you then complete credential setup in Google Cloud as prompted.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Google Chat channel integration or mention "add-gchat".

say_en.text: Add Google Chat to my project.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and registering the channel.
Installs the dependency and runs build and tests.
Follows the steps and guides you through the setup.
